references.text: Joshua commands the people to shout when he gives the signal, fulfilling the instruction to remain silent until he says 'Shout!'
The people shouted when they heard the sound of the horns, which was the moment Joshua had told them to wait for
The Book of Judges describes how the people cried out to the Lord in battle, a practice that originates from this command at Jericho
Proverbs about holding back one's words and keeping silence until the right time reflect the principle Joshua taught the people
Ecclesiastes teaches that there is a time to be silent and a time to speak, as illustrated by Joshua's command
In silence and trust your strength shall lie - the principle of waiting in silence for the Lord's salvation
